//: Workspace editor settings, kept to the minimum that makes the repository
read correctly. Nothing here builds, tests, formats or runs anything:
executable verification happens in GitHub Actions (AGENTS.md).
The .kts association exists because the recommended Kotlin extension
(JetBrains.kotlin-server) registers the .kt extension only, which leaves
build.gradle.kts and settings.gradle.kts unhighlighted. Mapping them to the
Kotlin language reuses the grammar that is already installed, rather than
recommending a second, lower-provenance extension for the same job.
//gdscript: GDScript indents with tabs, per the official style guide and gdformat,
which CI enforces. Stated here as well so the editor does not silently
insert spaces before the linter rejects them.
